title: Parametric Building Envelope — 3D
description: Real Three.js building shell with dimensional floor plates, facade bays, true opening geometry, glazing, and a spatial cutaway.
learningObjectives: Relate building width, depth, floor count, and floor-to-floor height to the resulting 3D envelope.
Inspect facade bay spacing, opening dimensions, sill height, and floor elevations as spatial geometry.
Use the cutaway to expose floor plates and interior depth without implying code compliance.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat procedural 3D geometry; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: The existing deterministic envelope model is preserved and now drives real Three.js geometry. Independent engineering, browser, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: 3D replacement of reserved buildings-agent task bld-building-envelope.
